prose: Relay, which makes cloud-hosted AI smart radios for frontline workers, raised $36M, bringing its total above $90M. International Paper led, with Cerity Partners Ventures and G2 Ventures. It wants to capture 'frontline intelligence' from workers on factory lines, hotels, hospitals and emergency response who aren't at desks.
highlights: $36M raise led by International Paper; $90M+ total.
Cloud smart radios for frontline workers.
Aims to capture 'frontline intelligence' with AI.
